scope: static real component mounts; not human operational UAT or compiled route acceptance
method: Visual inspection of all 48 desktop width/state combinations and the five non-identical mobile variants; byte equality for the other 43 pairs. No baseline-update option was used.
observations: Denied and failed reads expose no order data or false empty-state claim.
Dense rows remain inside the document viewport; table content can scroll horizontally at narrow widths.
Error after a previous read hides unsafe actions and offers a GET retry.
The synthetic empty admin fixture displays page 1 of 0; retained as current fixture rendering, not certified warehouse usability.
